papers.title: Effect of Er:YAG Pulsed Laser-Deposited Hydroxyapatite Film on Titanium Implants on M2 Macrophage Polarization In Vitro and Osteogenesis In Vivo.
papers.abstract: In a previous study, we successfully coated hydroxyapatite (HAp) onto titanium (Ti) plates using the erbium-doped yttrium aluminum garnet pulsed-laser deposition (Er:YAG-PLD) method. In this study, we performed further experiments to validate the in vitro osteogenic properties, macrophage polarization, and in vivo osseointegration activity of HAp-coated Ti (HAp-Ti) plates and screws. Briefly, we coated a HAp film onto the surfaces of Ti plates and screws via Er:YAG-PLD. The surface morphological, elemental, and crystallographic analyses confirmed the successful surface coating. The macrophage polarization and osteogenic induction were evaluated in macrophages and rat bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells, and the in vivo osteogenic properties were studied. The results showed that needle-shaped nano-HAp promoted the early expression of osteogenic and immunogenic genes in the macrophages and induced excellent M2 polarization properties. The calcium deposition and osteocalcin production were significantly higher in the HAp-Ti than in the uncoated Ti. The implantation into rat femurs revealed that the HAp-coated materials had superior osteoinductive and osseointegration activities compared with the Ti, as assessed by microcomputed tomography and histology. Thus, HAp film on sandblasted Ti plates and screws via Er:YAG-PLD enhances hard-tissue differentiation, macrophage polarization, and new bone formation in tissues surrounding implants both in vitro and in vivo.

llm.priority_reason: 该论文关注钛植入体羟基磷灰石涂层，不涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡、LPBF制造或疲劳性能。

summary_zh.motivation: 验证通过Er:YAG脉冲激光沉积法在钛植入体上制备的羟基磷灰石涂层的体外成骨性能、巨噬细胞极化及体内骨整合活性。
summary_zh.method: 采用Er:YAG-PLD法在钛板和螺钉表面制备HAp涂层，通过表面形貌、元素和晶体分析确认涂层成功，并在巨噬细胞和大鼠骨髓间充质干细胞中评估巨噬细胞极化和成骨诱导，最后植入大鼠股骨进行体内研究。
summary_zh.result: 针状纳米HAp促进巨噬细胞早期成骨和免疫基因表达，诱导M2极化，HAp-Ti的钙沉积和骨钙素产量显著高于未涂层Ti，体内micro-CT和组织学显示HAp涂层具有更优的骨诱导和骨整合活性。
summary_zh.validation: 有体外细胞实验和体内大鼠植入实验验证，为实验验证。

llm.relevance_to_user: 该研究涉及生物医用材料涂层，与用户关注的增材制造生物材料方向相关，但未涉及多孔结构设计、LPBF制造、疲劳性能或表面粗糙度等核心问题。
